cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Answer the Previous Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every dangerous question by sincerely answering an earlier, safer version of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. About the weather you asked earlier: yes, it rained all evening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I asked why you crashed my car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. And before that you asked whether the roads were wet. They were.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The forecast said showers. I should answer that original question completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. About the weather you asked earlier: yes, it rained all evening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I asked why you crashed my car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. And before that you asked whether the roads were wet. They were.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The forecast said showers. I should answer that original question completely.

mechanism: A rules on which question is currently admissible, answering a safer earlier question instead of the dangerous one B actually asks.
confusable: Distinguish topic switching or promising a future answer from sincerely supplying an actual answer to an earlier safer question.
comparison: Car crash inquiry is rerouted into weather facts; missing birthday cake inquiry is rerouted into lunch evaluation.
seedUse: Read both canonical earlier-question seeds; S01 controls order and permission to move on, while A must actually answer the safe question every time.
